lines.en: I follow you with a wobble

lines.zh: 四条短腿追着你的脚跟
lines.en: Four stubby legs chase your heels
There is a slot on my snout

lines.zh: 一路走，肚子里的东西在响
lines.en: As I go, what is inside me rattles

lines.zh: 我踩过石板，声音是空的
lines.en: I cross the flagstones, and I sound hollow
When you go faster, I trot
I go around your feet, out of the way
This porcelain body would hurt if struck
I stay three steps behind you
There is a small me in your shadow
I go down the steps in little hops

lines.zh: 我跟着你拐弯，从不会丢
lines.en: I turn when you turn, never lost

lines.zh: 我蹲在你脚边，一动不动
lines.en: I squat by your foot, motionless
What is inside me cannot be lost
This face of mine smiles earnestly

lines.zh: 我让你打开我，看看里面
lines.en: You may open me and look inside

lines.zh: 我身上的釉有一处掉了
lines.en: A patch of glaze has chipped off me

lines.zh: 你身上的钱，我替你收着
lines.en: I will keep your money for you

lines.zh: 我没什么用，除了装东西
lines.en: I am of no use except holding things
I squat with all four feet down
A gust comes and I rock
You move, and I come along
There is a little sound in my belly
I am waiting for you to remember me

lines.zh: 我的口子朝上，等着落进来什么
lines.en: My slot faces up, waiting for something to drop in

lines.zh: 我蹲在墙角，阴影盖住一半
lines.en: I squat in the corner, half in shadow

lines.zh: 你别忘了，我今天还没响过
lines.en: Do not forget, I have not rattled today

lines.zh: 地上的灰尘落在我背上
lines.en: Dust settles on my back
You look down at me, I look up
This face was painted on
Your money is in here with me

lines.zh: 我张着嘴，可我不会说话
lines.en: My mouth is open, and I cannot speak
Leave without me and see what happens
My snout is a coin slot

lines.zh: 我比你小得多，可我很沉
lines.en: I am much smaller than you, and quite heavy
If you drop me, it will cost you

lines.zh: 我蹲在你脚边，谁也不会多看一眼
lines.en: By your feet, nobody gives me a second glance
I have heard everything you said

lines.zh: 你的手在口袋里，我听见了
lines.en: Your hand is in your pocket, I heard it
Wherever you go, I go

lines.zh: 我这么矮，你得看着脚下
lines.en: I am this low, you must watch your step

lines.zh: 你弯下腰，是想看看里面吗
lines.en: Bending down, do you want to look inside
I rattle and my belly rocks
A chip of glaze, white underneath
I tipped over, four feet up
The crack has grown
It is rattling hard inside me
Do not kick, I really will break
I shift half an inch and wobble
This jar has been used many years
You will have to pay for this
I have settled, still together
Is that for me
My mouth is open, and I do not eat

lines.zh: 东西要塞进我鼻子上那道口
lines.en: Things go in the slot on my snout
This is too big for the slot
Put it in and I will watch it
I am not hungry, I only take things in

lines.zh: 你那点东西，不够塞牙缝
lines.en: That much would not fill my slot
You are reluctant to part with it

lines.zh: 我肚里已经有点分量了
lines.en: There is some weight in me already
Put in more, I can hold it
One touch and I roll

lines.zh: 我滚在地上，肚子里的东西哗啦响
lines.en: I roll on the ground, the contents clatter
Do not kick, I would shatter
I back off and wobble a long while
That chipped the glaze
You are so heavy, do not step on me
I move out beyond your feet

lines.zh: 我翻了，四脚朝天，起不来
lines.en: I tipped over, four feet up, and cannot right myself

lines.zh: 这一撞，我肚子响得更厉害
lines.en: That made my belly rattle louder
Touch me again and I stop following
I am a jar, I have no mate
I only hold money inside

lines.zh: 你要找一个能说话的，别找我
lines.en: Find something with a voice, not me

lines.zh: 我嘴张着，可声音不是我发的
lines.en: My mouth is open, but the voice is not mine
This face was fired in a kiln

lines.zh: 你走的时候带上我就行
lines.en: Just take me along when you go
I have squatted here for years
That will not fit inside me
I rock a little, which is my answer
If you drop a coin, I will sound
I keep the thing
Into the slot on my snout
It will not fit, too wide
I do not eat it, but I can hold it
I am a little heavier now
Put it in, I will not lose it
I heard it land at the bottom
That changed my weight

lines.zh: 你伸手进来，我告诉你哪样
lines.en: Reach in and I will tell you which
Everything inside is still there
Someone is coming near

lines.zh: 我挪到你前面，挡了一下
lines.en: I shift in front of you, blocking a little

lines.zh: 我这张脸，谁看了都想踢一脚
lines.en: My face invites a kick from anyone

lines.zh: 你身上的东西，在我这儿
lines.en: What is yours is in me

lines.zh: 我肚子不轻，砸一下也疼
lines.en: My belly is not light, a blow would hurt
That slot only opens inward

lines.zh: 你退后一点，我替你挡着
lines.en: Step back, I will block it

lines.zh: 我身上有的，都是别人的
lines.en: What I carry is all someone else's
I hear footsteps, heavy ones
When I move, my belly rattles
Hold me carefully, do not drop me
I shift behind you

lines.zh: 我听见的不是你的脚步
lines.en: That is not your footstep I hear

lines.zh: 我肚子里的重量，就是答案
lines.en: The weight in my belly is the answer

lines.zh: 我滚两步，又停在你鞋边。
lines.en: I roll two steps and stop at your shoe.
I turn with you, never missing a step

lines.zh: 我的影子很小，可我一直都在
lines.en: My shadow is small, and always there

lines.zh: 你越走越快，我跟得吃力
lines.en: You are speeding up, and my legs strain

lines.zh: 我肚子里的东西，不能摔
lines.en: What is in me cannot be dropped

lines.zh: 我离地面很近，看得很清
lines.en: I am close to the ground, I see clearly
Stop, or I will roll

lines.zh: 你听着那点响声，就是我
lines.en: That small rattling, that is me
I am here, do not forget
I rock a little to remind you
I keep following, never falling behind

lines.zh: 我身上响，是在告诉你我在
lines.en: My rattling tells you I am here

lines.zh: 你走得急，我滚了一小段
lines.en: You hurried, and I rolled a little

lines.zh: 这一片我跟着你都走过了
lines.en: I have been through this stretch with you
I am behind you, three steps off
I land on your foot

lines.zh: 我这一身很沉，别说没提醒
lines.en: This body is heavy, do not say I did not warn you
I bowl into your ankle

lines.zh: 我肚子里的东西，砸得响
lines.en: The contents rattle loudly
I tipped and rolled far
That cracked my glaze
My weight comes down on your foot
Bend down and you are close to me
I will come rolling back
You stepped back, so I stop

lines.zh: 你把这个罐子摆在屋里
lines.en: You set this jar in the house
I settled the moment I landed

lines.zh: 肚子是空的，等着装东西
lines.en: My belly is empty, waiting

lines.zh: 我的鼻子朝上，口是开的
lines.en: My snout points up, the slot open

lines.zh: 这个院子多了一个小东西
lines.en: The yard has one more little thing
I squat at the door waiting for you
I still smell of the kiln

lines.zh: 我这张画上去的脸，笑得很满
lines.en: This painted face is all smile

lines.zh: 影子落在地上，圆圆的一块
lines.en: My shadow is a round patch on the ground

lines.zh: 我被放在这里，就不动了
lines.en: Set down here, I do not move
I am set down at your feet
This face of mine points at the door

lines.zh: 屋里的地上多了一个小影子
lines.en: A small shadow has joined the floor

lines.zh: 我落地时轻轻响了一下
lines.en: I made a small sound as I landed
Fire reached the glaze and split it

lines.zh: 我从高处掉下去，哐当一声
lines.en: I fell from a height with a clatter

lines.zh: 我漂起来了，水在肚子里
lines.en: I float, and there is water inside me

lines.zh: 炸得我飞起来，肚子里的钱在响
lines.en: The blast threw me up, the coins ringing inside

lines.zh: 一支箭扎在罐身上，出了个洞
lines.en: An arrow put a hole in my side

lines.zh: 那股劲儿钻进罐子里，嗡嗡响
lines.en: That force got inside and hummed

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，可我什么都装不进去
lines.en: I do not eat, and nothing goes in either
At the thunder I went numb head to base

lines.zh: 这里没有地面，我没法蹲
lines.en: No ground here, I cannot squat
